Your track switch time at each station. Lower it and search again to find more.
Global offset of the track switch time
Optimization: your own track switch time at each station

Gleiswechsel looks for a faster trip than the official planner shows. The planner offers a change only if it takes at least the station\'s official track switch time, e.g. 5 minutes at Luzern. If you switch faster, an earlier train may still be yours.

The minutes in a box: how long you need from one train to the next, walk included. Under Optimization you can set your own at each station (− and +); elsewhere it\'s the official one plus the global offset in Settings (⚙), e.g. 5\u00A0−\u00A01\u00A0=\u00A04\u00A0minutes at Luzern. Green: below the official one, orange: the same, red: above.
How much faster than the official trip, from the first departure to the last arrival: 33 minutes instead of 47 is 42% more efficient (47 / 33 = 1.42).
Planned times only: a late train can make a short track switch impossible. Whether you make it is up to you.
Connections: transport.opendata.ch. Official track switch times: opentransportdata.swiss, timetable 2026. Not affiliated with SBB.
